title: Storage options must be scoped per-GVR, not registered into a shared GroupResource map
answers: Why did my object get persisted with the wrong apiVersion?
Dashboard v1 writes show up as v1beta1 in storage
App plugin settings apiVersion changed unexpectedly
How do I give one version different storage options than another version of the same resource?
body:
Symptom: an object is persisted under the wrong apiVersion (e.g. v1 dashboard writes stored as v1beta1; app-plugin Settings stored as the preferred manifest version instead of its defining version), or per-version options (like folder scope) silently get overridden by whichever version's store completes last.
Root cause: storage options traveled through a mutable map on the shared *apistore.RESTOptionsGetter keyed by GroupResource (builder.APIGroupOptions.StorageOptsRegister), so every version serving a resource read the same entry; pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go:checkGVK then fell back to Scheme.ObjectKinds, which reports every GVK a Go type is registered under in registration order (wrong for types aliased across versions, e.g. v1beta1.Dashboard = v1.Dashboard).
Fix pattern: scope the RESTOptionsGetter to the single store being completed instead of re-keying a shared map — use builder.APIGroupOptions.StorageOptsGetter(opts) or StorageOptsGetterFor(resourceInfo, opts) (which fills StorageOptions.GVK from the utils.ResourceInfo already passed to NewRegistryStore), and pass the result as the RESTOptions getter to that one CompleteWithOptions/NewRegistryStore call.
Constraints: use this for any new or migrated store; StorageOptsRegister still works for resources deliberately left on the encodeViaCodec path (no Scheme set), e.g. dashv2beta1.Variable/Notebook and dashv0.Snapshot — declaring a GVK there would switch them to direct-JSON encoding, a separate decision.
applies: Any API group builder registering storage for a resource served under multiple versions, or any resource whose Go type is shared/aliased across versions

Plugin settings are persisted under an unexpected api version number
How to apply different storage behavior to different versions of the same type
Each api version should support its own storage options without conflicts
search: Storage options must be scoped per-GVR, not registered into a shared GroupResource map — use builder.APIGroupOptions.StorageOptsGetter(opts) or StorageOptsGetterFor(resourceInfo, opts) to pass the RESTOptionsGetter to the specific store being completed, rather than re-keying a shared mutable map on *apistore.RESTOptionsGetter. Mutable map keying by GroupResource causes every version of a resource to read the same entry, leading to objects persisted under the wrong apiVersion (e.g. v1 dashboard written as v1beta1) and per-version options silently overridden by whichever store completes last. StorageOptsRegister still works for resources deliberately left on the encodeViaCodec path with no Scheme set (dashv2beta1.Variable/Notebook, dashv0.Snapshot), since declaring a GVK would switch to direct-JSON encoding. Applies to any API group builder registering storage for a resource served under multiple versions or shared/aliased across versions. Pointers: pkg/services/apiserver/builder/common.go:StorageOptsGetterFor, pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go:checkGVK, pkg/services/apiserver/kindstore/store.go:New.
